title: my son’s dream
content: My son (7 years) likes to tell me about dreams he remembers and usually they’re just normal dreams about people we know or everyday life. The other night he had a bad dream and the next day he said he could remember being in an indoor/outdoor playground. He said there was a giant ball pit too. He said only the ending of the dream was scary but he couldn’t remember why. I think it’s interesting that he’s having dreams like this since I know an indoor playground is in a lot of people’s mall world.
